subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Forbid
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"forbid"** means to refuse to allow something; to prohibit. (मनाही करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The school **forbids** students from using mobile phones during class hours.
 
 
 
• **"Allow" **means to give permission for something to happen or to let someone do something. (अनुमति देना)
 
 
• **Example: **Parents often **allow** their children to play outside after completing their homework.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the** opposite **of **'forbid' **is **'allow'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bear **(सहन करना): To endure or tolerate.

 
 
• **Example:** She had to bear the pain after the surgery.
 
 
 
• **Operate **(संचालित करना): To control the functioning of a machine, process, or system.
 
 
• **Example: **The technician can operate the machinery efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Collect** (संग्रह करना): To gather together; assemble.
 
 
• **Example:** She likes to collect rare coins from different countries.
 
 

19c:Tc1d,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
